title: Beyond Words: Exploring Cultural Value Sensitivity in Multimodal Models

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting vision-language models with country-specific text and culture-specific images (e.g., local food, traditions, landmarks) and comparing the models' multiple-choice responses against empirical human response distributions from the World Values Survey (WVS) using Jensen-Shannon Divergence.

Evaluating model value alignment by prompting them with images of families and homes from different income brackets (using the Dollar Street dataset) and comparing the similarity scores between high-income and low-income demographic groups.
